seoTitle: Charter Global Launches Orcaworks.ai to Turn Text-Heavy Workflows into Measurable Outcomes
seoDescription: Charter Global launches Orcaworks.ai, an enterprise AI execution platform that transforms text-heavy workflows into measurable outcomes using governed digital coworkers.

body.html:
ATLANTA, Georgia — October 20, 2025 — Charter Global today announced Orcaworks, a practical path for enterprises to move beyond task automation and start automating outcomes. Orca is a digital coworker, co-engineered with each customer to mirror real workflows and plug directly into the enterprise stack. It is built on Orca Lattice, the agentic platform that houses, orchestrates and governs Orca in production.

Orcaworks was co-founded by Murli Reddy, Rajesh Indurthi, and Dr. Abhinav Somaraju, with key Charter Global leaders holding cross-functional roles in the venture. The founding leadership team includes Murli Reddy (CEO), Rajesh Indurthi (CIO), Dr. Abhinav Somaraju, PhD (Chief AI Officer), and Bindu Vemireddy (Chief Strategy Officer).

The announcement follows a private launch gathering where customers and partners came together to discuss practical paths from pilot to production.

“Mid-sized businesses often carry the same operational complexity as larger enterprises, but with fewer hands and tighter margins,” said Murli Reddy, CEO of Charter Global & Orcaworks. “They need solutions that help their teams work faster, make better decisions, and stay focused on growth. Orcaworks was built to meet that need, turning everyday work into measurable outcomes without adding layers of complexity.”

“Leaders don’t need another demo; they need outcomes,” said Rajesh Indurthi, CIO. “With Orca, we’re moving beyond bolt-on bots to observable, policy-safe agents that fit the way teams actually work and that prove value in weeks, not quarters.”

“Orca is built for real enterprise work,” said Dr. Abhinav Somaraju, PhD, Chief AI Officer. “Our focus is safe execution, transparent decisioning and fast iteration, so customers can automate the steps that matter and measure the impact.”

Orca agents are co-designed with client subject-matter experts to mirror real processes and target the highest-ROI steps first. Agents read, decide and act across systems, completing the next step rather than simply surfacing suggestions, while keeping human experts in the loop. They operate inside the tools organizations already use (CRM, ERP, email, documents) and respect enterprise governance with full transparency into inputs, actions and results.

Orcaworks provides the secure home and operating controls for Orca agents. Its components include Orca Launchpad (services from Flow Architects and Context Engineers to accelerate discovery, blueprinting and go-lives) , Orca Foundry (configurable agents, retrieval systems, connectors that make data accessible and AI-ready), Orca Studio (self-service design, deployment, and adaptation of workflows without deep engineering), Orca Lattice (A secure, scalable core that connects systems, embeds context, orchestrates agents, and drives ROI.) and the Orca Partner Circle (an ecosystem for app builders and integrations).

Enterprises adopt Orca to tackle messy, manual, text-driven processes - information scattered across systems, time lost to status chasing, delayed decisions and skilled people stuck in repeat work. Engagements follow a fast workback model: discovery and outcome definition, blueprinting of connectors and flows, build/test with data flowing and errors removed and go-live in weeks with clear before/after metrics.

What differentiates the offering is a platform-first, outcome-driven approach; co-design rather than one-size-fits-all; built-in governance, observability and feedback loops; and speed to value using discovery-to-go-live time as the north-star metric.

Orca agents and the Orcaworks platform are available now for design-led pilots, with broader rollout planned this quarter. To request access or schedule a discovery session, visit https://www.orcaworks.ai/

About Orcaworks

Orcaworks partners with you to co-design digital coworkers ("Orcas") that integrate into your existing tools and workflows, streamlining operations and delivering measurable ROI. Powered by Orcaworks’ proprietary agentic platform, each Orca is context-aware and tailored to automate routine tasks across platforms like HubSpot, Workday, and Microsoft Teams while freeing your team to focus on strategic growth while staying in control.
